_comment: FEC names per (crate, AMC slot). These are assigned per installation, so they are a table, not a formula -- e.g. AMC1 of TVT..CD8 is FEC2..FEC10, but AMC2 of CD1 is FEC13. Fill in the slots you know; anything not listed still gets a name from 'fallback' so it is never blank. Restart mch-exporter@<crate> after editing; no rescan needed.

fallback._note: applied only to slots missing from the table: FEC<per_crate * crate_number + slot>
